models.name: todo_app_members
models.description:
Registered member account that serves as the authenticated owner of a private todo workspace.

This actor model stores the member's email-based sign-in identity and password credential for self-service registration and login. It is the root ownership record for private profile and todo data, while dependent authentication records such as sessions, password reset tokens, and email verification tokens are stored in separate child tables.

The application supports only self-owned access, so each record represents one private account holder rather than a shared or delegated identity.

plainFields.name: email
plainFields.description: Unique email address used as the member's sign-in identity.

plainFields.name: password_hash
plainFields.description: Hashed password credential used to authenticate the member account.

plainFields.name: email_verified
plainFields.description: Whether the member's email ownership has been verified for the account.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: When the member account was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: When the member account was last updated.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: When the member account was soft-deleted, if applicable.

models.name: todo_app_member_sessions
models.description:
Authenticated session records for member accounts in the private todo application.

Each record belongs to exactly one {@link todo_app_members} account and captures connection context for a successful sign-in, including client IP, accessed href, referrer, creation time, and expiration time. The table supports account-scoped session tracking and logout/session-lifecycle enforcement without storing unrelated business-domain data.

plainFields.name: ip
plainFields.description: Client IP address recorded for this authenticated session.

plainFields.name: href
plainFields.description: Requested application href associated with session creation.

plainFields.name: referrer
plainFields.description: Referrer value observed when the authenticated session was created.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this session record was created.

plainFields.name: expired_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this session expires and is no longer valid for authenticated access.

models.name: todo_app_member_password_resets
models.description:
Password reset tokens issued to members for secure account recovery.

This table stores one-time password reset credentials that belong to a specific {@link todo_app_members} record. Each record represents a reset issuance event with expiration and consumption tracking so the system can validate whether a token is still usable.

The table is an authentication support entity rather than a standalone business resource. Multiple reset records may exist for the same member over time, enabling auditability and safe recovery workflows without storing redundant member profile data in this table.

plainFields.name: token
plainFields.description: Unique password reset token presented by the member to prove reset authorization.

plainFields.name: used_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the password reset token was consumed. Null means the token has not been used yet.

plainFields.name: expired_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp after which the password reset token is no longer valid.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the password reset record was issued.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the password reset record was last updated.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft deletion timestamp for the password reset record.

models.name: todo_app_member_email_verifications
models.description:
Email verification records for {@link todo_app_members} that prove ownership of a member email address during registration or later verification flows.

Each row stores a single issued verification token and its lifecycle timestamps, including expiration, successful use, and optional revocation. The table is a supporting authorization artifact rather than an independently managed business entity, and it maintains a many-to-one relationship back to the owning member account for auditing and security workflows.

plainFields.name: token
plainFields.description: Unique email verification token issued to confirm member email ownership.

plainFields.name: expired_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the verification token becomes invalid if it has not been used.

plainFields.name: used_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the verification token was successfully consumed for email verification.

plainFields.name: revoked_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the verification token was invalidated before use due to replacement or security action.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this verification record was issued.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this verification record was last updated.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft deletion timestamp for this verification record.

models.name: todo_app_profiles
models.description:
Private profile record for a member account within the todo application's personal workspace.

This table stores profile-specific identity data that is separate from authentication credentials in {@link todo_app_members}. Each profile belongs to exactly one member through a one-to-one relationship and is visible only within that member's private account scope.

The model is intentionally minimal and normalized, keeping only profile attributes such as the display name while account login data remains in the actor table.

plainFields.name: display_name
plainFields.description: Private display name shown for the member inside the personal workspace.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the profile record was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the profile was last updated.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft deletion timestamp for the profile record when it becomes inactive or is removed through account lifecycle handling.

models.name: todo_app_todos
models.description:
Private todo items owned by a registered member within the personal todo workspace.

This table stores the core task data that members directly create, browse, update, complete, move to trash, restore, and permanently remove. Each todo belongs to exactly one {@link todo_app_members} record and remains private to that owner.

The model keeps only atomic task attributes and lifecycle state needed for active-list and trash behavior. Historical edit details are intentionally excluded from this table and belong in the separate child history model linked through this todo.

plainFields.name: title
plainFields.description: Required task title shown in the member's private todo lists.

plainFields.name: description
plainFields.description: Optional longer task description entered by the member for additional details.

plainFields.name: start_date
plainFields.description: Optional planned start date and time for the todo.

plainFields.name: due_date
plainFields.description: Optional due date and time for the todo.

plainFields.name: completed
plainFields.description: Whether the todo is currently marked as completed.

plainFields.name: completed_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the todo was most recently marked completed.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: When the todo was originally created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: When the todo was last updated.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: When the todo was moved to trash. Null means the todo is still in the active list.

models.name: todo_app_todo_edit_histories
models.description:
Chronological edit history records for a member-owned todo.

Each row captures one recorded edit event for a specific {@link todo_app_todos.id} so the application can list a todo's edit timeline in chronological order. This table is a historical child entity of the todo and keeps only child-specific audit data rather than duplicating parent todo fields.

History rows remain associated with the parent todo while it exists, and their lifecycle is expected to follow the parent todo and owning account through cascade policies managed by parent entities.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this history entry was created as the recorded edit event.
